phase_a_dependency_order.name: discover_and_map
phase_a_dependency_order.description: Verify workspace, target page, permissions, capabilities, and paginated existing databases before creating anything.

phase_a_dependency_order.name: create_databases_and_base_properties
phase_a_dependency_order.description: Create missing required databases and independent scalar/select/status/date/url/file/managed properties. Preserve native Status on Goals versus Select on other databases.

phase_a_dependency_order.name: link_internal_relations
phase_a_dependency_order.description: Configure all required internal bidirectional and unidirectional relations using newly verified target IDs (never source snapshot IDs).

phase_a_dependency_order.name: configure_derived_fields
phase_a_dependency_order.description: Configure required formulas only when verified formula expressions are supplied/exposed, then configure rollups targeting those formulas. If any required formula remains unknown, keep Phase A explicitly partial.

phase_a_dependency_order.name: optional_external_integrations_and_views
phase_a_dependency_order.description: Link optional Google Drive File relation only if a verified external source exists; never create an 8th database. Preserve existing views; additional views are optional.

phase_a_dependency_order.name: verify_phase_a_gate
phase_a_dependency_order.description: Re-read live schema for all seven databases and confirm every required component before allowing Phase B (user-supplied data insertion).

phase_b_policy.gate: Blocked until Phase A required structure is fully verified.
phase_b_policy.data_rule: Insert only explicit user-supplied records in safe dependency order (Areas -> Goals -> Projects -> Stages -> Tasks -> Notes & References / Inbox). Never insert sample data or templates unless requested. If the user asked only to create the structure, omit Phase B completely.
